gif-resizer.formula:
New delay = old delay ÷ speed
Output pixels = out width × out height
Raw frame memory = width × height × 4 bytes
Example: 480 × 270 × 4 = 518,400 bytes per frame

gif-resizer.workedExample:
Take a 480 × 270 GIF with 20 frames at 100 ms per frame.

Raw memory = 480 × 270 × 4 bytes = 518,400 bytes per frame
20 frames = 10,368,000 bytes ≈ 9.9 MB uncompressed
Duration = 20 × 0.1 s = 2.0 seconds

Resize to 240 × 135 (one quarter of the pixels) with 128 colors:
raw per frame = 240 × 135 × 4 = 129,600 bytes — 4× less data before LZW even starts.

At 2× speed: new delay = 100 ÷ 2 = 50 ms per frame, duration = 1.0 s.
Typical result: a file 60–80% smaller that still loops smoothly.
